title: Another Word for "Different": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for "different" in English. Don't just say "Different". Here are three better words:
• Distinct. (clearly separate)
• Diverse. (of many kinds)
• Unusual. (not the usual kind)

Want more words for different? Watch the full lesson on this channel: Another Word For Different
